name: Beast Master
summary: An animal-bonded Ranger who commands a freely chosen roster of companions and divides effective Druid levels among them.

features.name: Beast Master Animal Bond
features.summary: Gain +2 Wild Empathy and Handle Animal with your companions; effective Druid level initially equals Ranger level –3.

features.name: Companion Roster
features.summary: Choose any number of companions and divide your available effective Druid levels among them.

features.name: Improved Empathic Link
features.summary: Communicate empathically with every companion within 1 mile and see through one companion's eyes as a swift action.

features.name: Strong Bond
features.summary: Your total effective Druid level for companion allocation becomes equal to your Ranger level.
